description_en: When you use Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) for the first time, you must call the OpenAckService operation to activate the service
description_zh: 首次使用容器服务Kubernetes版（Alibaba Cloud Container Service for Kubernetes，简称容器服务ACK）时，您需要调用OpenAckService接口开通服务
name: OpenAckService

parameters.help_en:
The type of service to activate. Valid values:

`propayasgo`: Container Service for Kubernetes (including ACK managed clusters and ACK dedicated clusters), Container Service Serverless, and registered clusters.
`edgepayasgo`: Container Service Edge
parameters.help_zh:
待开通的服务类型。可选值：

`propayasgo`：容器服务Kubernetes版（包括ACK托管集群和ACK专有集群）、容器服务Serverless版、注册集群。
`edgepayasgo`：容器服务Edge版
parameters.name: type

order_id.description_en: The order ID of the service activation
